name: wake-coop-rec
description: wake-coop with the server-side replay recorder preloaded: a 32-bit recorder.so samples every registered object from inside bf1942_lnxded (config: mods/bf1942/settings/recorder.con, off by default). Same round as wake-coop so the two recordings can be compared.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Let the round run at least 60 s of fighting, then `lab.py stop`.
